logos.r4-01: r3-01 var: heavier arcs (18 vs 13) and bigger heads. Reads louder, holds up smaller.
logos.r4-02: r3-01 var: lighter arcs (9) and wider letter spacing. The quiet end of the family.
logos.r4-03: r3-01 var: arcs pulled apart. Two clearly separate pieces, more open.
logos.r4-04: r3-01 var: arcs pulled together, close to sealing into a ring. Denser, more solid.
logos.r4-05: r3-01 var: one colour, all navy. Survives single-colour printing and stamps.
logos.r4-06: r3-01 var: one colour, all teal, with a darker teal name. Warmest of the ten.
logos.r4-07: r3-01 var: knocked out of a solid teal square. The app icon, ready made.
logos.r4-08: r3-01 var: contained inside a thin navy ring. More formal, more badge-like.
logos.r4-09: r3-01 var: stacked instead of side by side. Better for narrow spaces and avatars.
logos.r4-10: r3-01 var: bigger mark, brighter teal, tighter name. Symbol leads, name follows.
